summary: PFD fails 3 hard gates. The problem statement lacks a why-now rationale, opportunity sizing has no stated basis, and the document introduces a solution proposal that violates scope.

blocking_issues.description: The problem statement identifies who experiences the problem and what the problem is, but contains no 'why now' rationale. The urgency condition (competitor launch, churn data, deadline) is absent.
Opportunity sizing is present ($3M ARR at risk) but no basis for the estimate is stated. A number without a source or methodology does not satisfy the hard gate.

Section §9 Constraints contains the statement: 'The team believes a rule-based classification engine is the right approach.' This is a solution proposal and must not appear in a problem framing document.

warnings.description: Pain point for UG-3 (Executive Stakeholders) lists no frequency. A pain point without frequency cannot be prioritized or traced to a hypothesis.
